 A Moment to Remember: School Concert Celebrates Talent and Creativity
 The Mellow Oaks Academy School Concert was a spectacular showcase of talent, creativity, and school spirit, bringing together learners, parents, teachers, and friends for an unforgettable moment of entertainment and celebration.
 The concert provided a wonderful platform for our learners to shine beyond the classroom. From captivating musical performances and energetic dance routines to dramatic performances and heartwarming presentations, the evening highlighted the incredible talents and dedication of our students.
 Months of preparation, practice, and teamwork culminated in a performance that left the audience inspired and thoroughly entertained. Learners embraced the opportunity to express themselves, build confidence, and share their gifts with the wider school community.
 One of the most rewarding aspects of the evening was witnessing the enthusiasm and determination of our learners. Their hard work was evident in every performance, and their confidence on stage re

 We extend our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated teachers, staff, and parents whose support, encouragement, and commitment made this event possible. Their efforts behind the scenes ensured that the evening was a resounding success.
 Most importantly, we congratulate our learners for their outstanding performances. Each participant contributed to creating a memorable experience that showcased the vibrant spirit of Mellow Oaks Academy.

chunks.x:
Home / News 
 School news 17 April 2026 
 A Special Morning with “Best Buddy in a Shell” at Mellow Oaks Academy
 Our Foundation Phase learners had a morning to remember! We were delighted to welcome the author of Best Buddy in a Shell for a heartwarming visit that left little smiles all around.
 She read her beautiful story to our Grade R to Grade 3 learners and shared a powerful life lesson: we can all be friends, no matter the differences. Through the story of a shy creature finding friendship, our children learned that kindness, empathy, and inclusion matter more than how we look or where we come from.
 The excitement didn’t stop at the story. Each child received their very own copy of Best Buddy in a Shell to take home. And as a special surprise, our guest brought along lovely shells for every learner — a tangible reminder of the day’s message to cherish and hold onto.
 We saw thoughtful questions, big hugs for new friends, and lots of careful shell examining during break time. It was the kind of morning that sticks with you.
 Thank you to the author for spending time with our Me

chunks.t: Creativity Meets Sustainability – Grade 8’s Recycled Fashion Showcase
chunks.x:
Home / News 
 Academics 12 June 2026 
 Creativity Meets Sustainability – Grade 8’s Recycled Fashion Showcase
 At Mellow Oaks Academy, innovation and imagination are always encouraged — and our Grade 8 learners recently proved just how powerful those qualities can be. In a project that combined environmental awareness with artistic flair, the students designed and created garments entirely out of recycled materials.
 Turning Waste into Wonder
 The initiative challenged learners to rethink everyday items that might otherwise end up in landfills. Plastic bags became flowing skirts, newspapers were transformed, and bottle caps found new life as dazzling accessories. Each garment told a story of sustainability, showing that fashion can be both stylish and eco-conscious.

chunks.t: Creativity Meets Sustainability – Grade 8’s Recycled Fashion Showcase
chunks.x:
A Runway of Ideas
 The project culminated in a vibrant showcase where students proudly modelled their creations. Alive with colour, texture, and originality. Parents, teachers, and fellow students were amazed at the creativity on display, applauding the learners’ ability to merge artistry with environmental responsibility.

chunks.t: Creativity Meets Sustainability – Grade 8’s Recycled Fashion Showcase
chunks.x:
Lessons Beyond the Classroom
 This project wasn’t just about fashion; it was about fostering a mindset of sustainability. By working with recycled materials, learners gained a deeper appreciation for the importance of reducing waste and protecting our planet. They also developed teamwork, problem-solving, and design skills — all while having fun and expressing themselves.

chunks.t: Grade 3’s 3D Recycled Art Exhibition – Insects & Creepy Crawlies
chunks.x:
Home / News 
 Academics 11 June 2026 
 Grade 3’s 3D Recycled Art Exhibition – Insects & Creepy Crawlies
 At Mellow Oaks Academy, creativity is buzzing — quite literally! Our Grade 3 learners recently unveiled their imaginative 3D art, where the theme was insects and creepy crawlies . Using only recycled materials, the young artists transformed everyday waste into extraordinary creatures that crawled, fluttered, and wriggled across the display.
 From Trash to Treasure
 Plastic bottles became beetle bodies, egg cartons turned into caterpillars, and tin foil was shaped into shimmering dragonfly wings. Each piece showcased how discarded items can be reimagined into something beautiful and meaningful. The learners proved that art doesn’t need expensive supplies — just vision, teamwork, and a commitment to sustainability.
 Lessons in Sustainability
 Beyond the fun of creating, the project taught learners valuable lessons about caring for the environment. By working with recycled materials, they discovered how waste can be repurposed, reducing our impact on the planet. It was a hands-on way

chunks.t: Grade 3’s 3D Recycled Art Exhibition – Insects & Creepy Crawlies
chunks.x:
to connect art, science, and sustainability.
 Celebrating Young Creativity
 The Grade 3 exhibition was a joyful celebration of imagination and eco-consciousness. At Mellow Oaks Academy, we are proud of our learners for showing that even the smallest creatures — and the smallest actions — can make a big difference.

chunks.t: Investigating Life Science: Grade 11 Kidney Dissection
chunks.x:
Home / News 
 Academics 19 August 2026 
 Investigating Life Science: Grade 11 Kidney Dissection
 Yesterday, our Grade 11 Life Science learners engaged in a fascinating practical lesson — the dissection of a lamb kidney. This hands-on activity allowed students to move beyond theory and explore the intricate anatomy of one of the body’s vital organs.
 The lesson objective was clear: by the end of the session, learners should be able to identify and label the anatomical structures of the kidney while also demonstrating growth in their investigative and scientific inquiry skills .
 With scalpels in hand and curiosity at heart, our learners carefully examined the kidney’s outer cortex, inner medulla, and renal pelvis — gaining a deeper appreciation for how this organ functions to filter blood and maintain homeostasis.
 This practical not only strengthened their understanding of human biology but also nurtured essential skills such as observation, analysis, and scientific communication. It was inspiring to see learners working collaboratively, asking thoughtful questions, and making connec

chunks.t: Investigating Life Science: Grade 11 Kidney Dissection
chunks.x:
tions between classroom knowledge and real-world application.
 At Mellow Oaks Academy, we believe that learning by doing is the key to unlocking deeper understanding. The kidney dissection was a perfect example of how experiential learning empowers students to become confident, capable investigators of the natural world.

chunks.t: Thermal Separation in Action: Grade 8 Science
chunks.x:
Home / News 
 Academics 1 May 2026 
 Thermal Separation in Action: Grade 8 Science
 In our Grade 8 classroom, science isn’t just about reading from textbooks — it’s about discovery, experimentation, and seeing theory come alive. This week, our students explored thermal separation of compounds , a fascinating process that uses heat to separate mixtures into their pure components.
 Thermal separation is more than just heating substances — it’s about understanding how different compounds respond to heat . Some evaporate, some crystallize, and others sublimate. By carefully applying heat, we can separate mixtures like salt water, camphor and sand, or even iron filings mixed with sulphur.

chunks.t: Thermal Separation in Action: Grade 8 Science
chunks.x:
Why It Matters
 Experiments like these teach students that science is not abstract — it’s practical, visual, and hands-on. They learn:
 How heat energy affects matter.
 The difference between physical separation and chemical reactions.
 The importance of safety and precision in the lab.
 Watching the video alongside this blog post will give parents and peers a glimpse into the excitement of discovery. It’s not just about separating compounds — it’s about sparking curiosity and building confidence in scientific thinking.

chunks.x:
Home / News 
 School news 4 August 2026 
 Welcoming Our New Principal: Mr. Quinten Poley
 Mellow Oaks Academy is proud to announce the appointment of our new Principal, Mr. Quinten Poley , a seasoned educator and leader whose career spans more than three decades of dedication to teaching and school leadership. His journey from the classroom to the principal’s office is a testament to resilience, passion, and an unwavering commitment to education.
 Mr. Poley began his teaching career in 1989 at a township school, where he quickly established himself as a strong and inspiring educator. Over the years, he rose through the ranks — from Departmental Head of Life Sciences and Physical Science, to Deputy Principal, and eventually Principal at Florida Park High School. His leadership extended further when he took on the role of Principal at Westrand Private School before joining us here at Mellow Oaks Academy.
 In his own words: “I am as excited to take on this new role at Mellow Oaks Academy as I was 36 years ago when I first entered the profession.” — Quinten Poley (Gen X Principal)
 We ar

e thrilled to welcome Mr. Poley to our community. His wealth of experience, deep understanding of education, and genuine enthusiasm for shaping young minds will undoubtedly guide Mellow Oaks Academy into a bright future.
 Please join us in extending a warm welcome to Mr. Poley as he embarks on this exciting new chapter with us. Together, we look forward to building on our tradition of excellence and innovation in education.
